basic_info.description: Charming Silver Terrace Spanish Mediterranean center-patio home offering convenience and classic appeal. Ideally located near public transit, with quick freeway access just minutes to downtown San Francisco or peninsula, and just several short blocks to San Bruno Avenue shops and restaurants. The top level showcases a spacious east-facing living room with an original fireplace, a formal dining room, and a bright breakfast room adjoining the kitchen, all enhanced by natural light from the signature center patio. A full bath with separate shower and tub serves two generous side-by-side bedrooms at the rear. An interior staircase leads to a lower-level addition featuring a comfortable family room, an extra bedroom, and a powder room (unsure of legality of the ground floor living space). The large garage accommodates 1-2 cars and offers abundant storage or potential for future expansion. From this level, enjoy direct access to a sizable backyard complete with a storage shed - perfect for gardening, outdoor entertaining, or simply relaxing at home. This home was freshly painted in & out while the original hardwood floors on the top were newly refinished. New flooring installed in the kitchen and ground floor rooms.
